Based on the provided fiscal year-end 2025 financial data, the company demonstrates high profitability with $12.72B in revenue, an operating margin of 19%, and net income of $2.54B, supported by massive retained earnings of $87.66B. However, the balance sheet presents a highly leveraged capital structure with total liabilities of $111.27B against shareholders' equity of $18.68B (debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 5.96) and a tight liquidity profile represented by a current ratio of 1.04. This combination of strong operating profitability but aggressive leverage and tight short-term liquidity aligns with a solid, investment-grade profile but constrains the rating to the lower end of the high-credit-quality tier.

DECISION: BBB+
